_comment: Pan configuration. Paths are configuration, keyed by host name, never
assumed by code (base role s2; WORKING_CONTRACT.md s9). Environment
separated). On M2 the lake is on the NVMe volume: fsync-heavy or
small-write work on M2's SMR volume stalled the SFE ledger 2026-09-17.
Nothing in this file is a credential.

index_exclude._why: Evaluation fixtures and their results contain the test queries and answer paths verbatim; indexing them lets the index find its own answer key (observed 2026-10-09 after the first refresh: three CONTROLS_*.json files ranked 1-3 for a held-out query). Excluded from chunking; still catalogued as artifacts.
